description: Learned vs exact head Jacobian by window length F on kernel-scan checkpoints (supplementary/exploratory; inference and autodiff only, no training).

reading_rule.statistic: R(F) = norm_ratio_S4 / norm_ratio_MLP, residual block PCs 3..F
reading_rule.supported: R(F64) > R(F16) in all 3 draws and R(F64) > 1 in all 3 draws
reading_rule.refuted: R(F64) <= R(F16) in at least 2 of 3 draws

settings.per_window_then_mean: norm ratio and cosine computed per window, averaged over windows, then over t
